text.en:
Currency Act
(CHAPTER 69)
Currency
(Denominations and Characteristics of Coins)
Notification 2016
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 24 June 2016 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

THE SCHEDULE
DESCRIPTION OF THE SPLENDOUR OF NATIVE ORCHIDS SERIES COIN SET TO BE ISSUED ON 24 JUNE 2016

Round
Milled
In each coin —
(a)the background is shiny silver;
(b)the Singapore Coat of Arms is engraved in the centre of the coin with the year-date “2016” below it;
(c)the word “SINGAPORE” appears once in each of the 4 official languages and engraved on the coin near its circumference; and
(d)the mintmark is engraved on the coin near its circumference at 5 o’clock of the coin.
1. The coin set features 10 different coin designs, each featuring one of the orchids named below:

finlaysonianum;

(j)Dendrobium
secundum.
2. In each design —
(a)the coin has a matt centre within a shiny silver annulus;
(b)the denomination “$1” is in shiny silver and placed at 9 o’clock of the matt centre;
(c)the orchid is featured in colour and occupies part of the matt centre complementary to the denomination and part of the right annulus;
(d)the botanical name of the orchid is engraved and occupies the upper annulus beginning above 9 o’clock; and
(e)the fineness of the coin is engraved and occupies the lower left quadrant of the annulus.
